newsitem.title: UK: Smiths gains, currency worries overdone.
newsitem.headline: Smiths gains, currency worries overdone.

text.p: Shares in Smiths Industries rose on Wednesday after analysts at SocGen commented that currency worries were overdone, adding that they remained positive on the stock following a meeting with the company on Tuesday.
The shares were up 12-1/2p at 781p by 1129 GMT.
SocGen analyst Zafar Khan said the stock deserved its premium to the rest of the sector because of the quality of the group's earnings, its cash generation and strength of management.
"We think Smiths is a core holding in the sector although at these levels we think the stock is fairly valued," he said.
Khan said the main impact of the meeting was to calm fears over the impact of currency fluctuations.
"The group is heavily exposed to the U.S. dollar but all their transactions are hedged, and because the group has fairly sizeable dollar borrowings the translation to sterling isn't huge."
